<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state(fr):
    g=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    pb=None
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b' and 20<=n['pixels']<=26:
            b=n['boundary']; pb=(b[0][0],b[0][1])
    row=g[38]; runs=[]; c=0
    while c<len(row):
        if row[c]=='R':
            s=c
            while c<len(row) and row[c]=='R': c+=1
            runs.append((s,c-1))
        else: c+=1
    em=[r for r in runs if r[1]-r[0]>=4]
    return pb, (em[0][0] if em else None)
print("start:", state(current_frame))
action(['RIGHT']*4)
print("after RIGHTx4 (expect player (8,38), em 20):", state(current_frame))
action(['SPACE'])
print("after SPACE at (8,38):", state(current_frame))
action(['LEFT']*4)
print("after LEFTx4 back (expect player (8,14)): em?", state(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
